_comment: Phase 3 crop database (ROADMAP.md Phase 3's 4 post-apoc crops). Loaded by scripts/crop_db.gd. growth_stages is the count of visual stages (checklist range 4-6, varied across crops here to demonstrate the range rather than using one number everywhere); a plot's stage index is 0-based and stage (growth_stages-1) is 'mature' / harvestable, per the growth rule in scripts/farm_grid.gd (advance_plot). sprite_dir holds stage_0.png..stage_{n-1}.png, PixelLab-generated (see art/crops/README.md for provenance). yield_item/yield_quantity is what harvesting grants.
